# The Pragmatic Method Is an Attitude of Orientation[^1]

No particular results then, so far, but only an attitude of orientation, is what the pragmatic method means. _THE ATTITUDE OF LOOKING AWAY FROM FIRST THINGS, PRINCIPLES, 'CATEGORIES,' SUPPOSED NECESSITIES; AND OF LOOKING TOWARDS LAST THINGS, FRUITS, CONSEQUENCES, FACTS._

[^1]: [[@Pragmatism - William James]]
